# Metronomics
Observations on measurements and precision

One is either early or late. This is the domain of time, a natural force; the Domain of the Experienced (or of Natural Elementary.) However, three states reveal another Domain; the Domain of the Observable.: Prepared, Over-prepared or under-prepared.  This implies two fundmental Domains; Experiential and Observational. 

## Fundamental Measurements
In Metronomics (temporary term) Pattern, Range, Proportion, Scale and Weight are the fundametnal measurements. Whereas Mathematics measures precision to the nth-degree. This gives Mathematics recursive abilities (Fractals, Polynomials, etc.) wheras it is often too abstract or intangible to apply to everyday life. That is the purpose of Metronomics; to fill the space between the Known and the Measureable
